method: Author self-score on the reviewer's rubric: silhouette and proportions 24/30, signature features 23/25, surface detail and material read 15/20, colour and value 13/15, readability at play distance 9/10. Judged from spring-hound.fidelity-compare.jpg (orthographic EEVEE renders of the low-poly model at the concept's side, front and back angles, framed at the concept's own metres per pixel: side 1.2 m / 855 px, front and back 1.21 m / 875 px) side by side, and from the six in-engine shots in staging/engine (shared brass sets with the manifest tint, hound-glow through the runtime D11 glow; glow-close is idle through a 30 degree lens aimed at the upper body). Widths are background-difference masks in the compare's front panels (1.845 mm per panel px, the reviewer's rows reproduced on the previous compare as 234 against 213 and 206 against 179). Changes since the independent 79 (pass 3): head-on the shoulders are 214 px against the concept's 214 at the reviewer's row 1270 (was 234) and 178 against 180 at row 1220 (was 206); by height band the model front is 0.395 m against 0.395 at z 0.69 to 0.71 (was 0.432), and the head now tapers from the brow down like the concept: 0.177 against 0.188 at z 1.08 to 1.11 (was 0.155), 0.170 against 0.177, 0.157 against 0.162 and 0.151 against 0.151 at the neck coil (was 0.168). The muzzle is a flat-topped wedge. The jaw is rotated 3.5 degrees closed and idle opens it only 0.5 to 2 degrees: the gap under the muzzle is 2.2 to 4.9 mm at rest and 4.5 to 9.3 mm through idle (head frame, y 0.80; was 25 to 38), and the upper teeth hang outside the jaw sides along the lip line, at least 3.0 mm clear of the jaw in every clip. The topline rises over the loin, the rump cowl ends at z 0.69 with a curved back edge, and the keel is a short blunt blade ending at y 0.045 (was a needle). The winding key is a solid flat plate with two 14 mm holes on a 26 mm barrel (bow centroid 0.2 mm off the spin axis). Rubies are taller 56 mm cabochons and the shoulder pair is turned 20 degrees toward the seat on a 30 mm socket: with the reviewer's mask (hue over 320 or under 5, S over 0.35, V over 0.12, whole frame) the idle red area is 190 px against 90 on the previous build (frozen 160 against 66, glow-close 586 against 241), per-pixel median S 0.68 idle, 0.70 frozen, 0.72 glow-close (was 0.59 to 0.61). Seams are a bevelled aged-brass rib split by a gunmetal hairline about 2 mm wide where it clears the bead. The glow-close wood grain and rope striations came from the sets' ORM red (AO) channel tiling every 0.5 m, not the normal map (a normalScale 0 build kept them unchanged); every brass face now samples one AO-255 texel of its set, with the slot tint scaled by 0.87 for the lost AO mean, and the grain is gone (engine idle head V 0.47, chest V 0.61, within 0.02 of the tiled build). The compare lighting is the fixed warden-matched rig and was not tuned to the score.
gaps: The tail hangs to a key at z 0.45 m, where the concept's tail curls back up to a key at about 0.54 m; the head sits low on a forward neck rather than the concept's more upright one (both need bone moves: tail.4 and key heads, neck.1, neck.2 and head).
Ruby saturation is still short of the concept: per-pixel median S 0.68 (idle), 0.70 (frozen), 0.72 (glow-close) against the concept's 0.91, although the red area roughly doubled.

Brass now has no set micro-texture at all (one texel per set, so neither AO nor the normal map varies): up close the plates read as clean, slightly plastic polished metal rather than the concept's lightly worn brass.
In the Blender front compare the polished skull mirrors the dark backdrop (head reads near black); the engine head reads lit (V 0.47).

Glow hue is the project's amber (F08C2C): the engine grille and eyes are hue 33 to 42 against the concept's 25, and in the Blender compare the grille, lenses and eyes read peach at the GLOW_STRENGTH 0.7 convention.
At play distance the seam hairline is faint even at the widened core: the diagonal chest seams read as thin brass ribs from the seat and show the dark split only at glow-close.
Legs are still mostly plated cylinders below the forearm and gaskin; paws are simpler than the concept's arched, individually jointed toes, and the far-side legs are not staggered.
In the engine idle frame the chest prow's key-light highlight lifts the chest brass to V 0.61 (concept 0.45 to 0.53).
